motive.zhHans: 警方执行了搬运，因为那是被害人的遗物之一。Rumi 只需把键盘往远离架子鼓的方向移动一点，好让其他人把自拍杆移到监控摄像头前面。被害人相信自己要为 Akane 的死负责，不是因为她严厉批评了她的声音，而是因为她和 Akane 约定在声音好转之前不出声。这就是 Akane 冲上马路而不是喊叫的原因，因为喊叫会伤到她的嗓子。事故（过去）地点：公路交叉口被害人：Akane Shuto死因：被车撞死案件结束后，世良向兰和园子透露，她之所以成为侦探，是因为她的大哥 Shuichi，他是一名 FBI 探员。
motive.en: The police carried it out because it was one of the victims belongings. Rumi just had to move the keyboard further away from the drums so that the others would have moved the selfie stick to in front of the cctv camera. The victim had believed that she was responsible for Akane's death, not because of her harsh words about her voice, but because she had made a deal with her not to speak until her voice had gotten better. This was why Akane ran into the road rather then shouting, because it would hurt her voice. Accident (Past) Location: Highway Intersection Victim: Akane Shuto Cause of death: Hit by a car After the case, Masumi revealed to Ran and Sonoko that the reason she became a detective was because of her oldest brother Shuichi, who is an FBI agent.

resolution.zhHans: 警方已经检查过所有形似线的物品，并进行了鲁米诺测试。然而柯南、安室和世良揭露，凶器已经离开了录音室。警方执行了搬运，因为那是被害人的遗物之一。凶手把她的针织帽拆开，用拆开的毛线作为凶器，然后用鼓棒把帽子重新织回去。安室揭露犯人就是 Rumi Kogure。另外两名嫌疑人进入房间是为了做一些不可能事先计划的事情。而 Rumi 据称是背对镜头演奏键盘，没有人看得见她在做什么。她一直在偷偷把帽子织回去。由于架子鼓固定不动，自拍杆摄像头的位置取决于键盘的位置。Rumi 只需把键盘往远离架子鼓的方向移动一点，好让其他人把自拍杆移到监控摄像头前面。她还在被害人的水瓶里下了安眠药，以确保被害人处于熟睡状态。
resolution.en: The police have already checked all of the items that resemble string and have tested for luminol. However Conan, Amuro, and Masumi reveal that the weapon has already left the studio. The police carried it out because it was one of the victims belongings. The murderer had taken her knit hat and unraveled it and used it as the murder weapon and then knitted it back together using the drumsticks. Amuro reveals that the culprit is Rumi Kogure. The other two suspects had gone into the room to do things that couldn't have been planned. Where as Rumi was supposedly playing her keyboard with her back to the camera where no one could see what she was doing. She had secretly been knitting the hat back together. With the drums fixed in place, the placement of the selfie stick camera would be dependent on the position of the keyboard. Rumi just had to move the keyboard further away from the drums so that the others would have moved the selfie stick to in front of the cctv camera. She has also spiked the victims water bottle with sleeping pills to ensure that she was asleep.
